title: tslint is deprecated
summary: npm marks tslint as deprecated: "TSLint has been deprecated in favor of ESLint. Please see https://github.com/palantir/tslint/issues/4534 for more information."

constraints: Preserve the enforced rule set and any custom rules; map each TSLint rule to its typescript-eslint or ESLint equivalent.

steps.title: Replace TSLint with ESLint
steps.instructions: Replace tslint with eslint and typescript-eslint in dependencies and scripts, and port the rules from tslint.json to the ESLint configuration.

steps.title: Port custom rules and disables
steps.instructions: Convert `tslint:disable` comments and any custom TSLint rules to their ESLint equivalents.

verification.purpose: Run the new linter on the project and compare the findings.
